params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Master Yi}} {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for a few seconds. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack will consume them all to strike a second time for reduced {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Master Yi's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, '''Master Yi's''' next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} and strike twice, the second strike dealing {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
params.description2: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
params.description3: If '''Master Yi's''' primary target is killed before the second strike, he will automatically target another nearby enemy.
params.description4: ''The second strike can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} against {{tip|turrets|structures}}.''
params.notes:
* The second strike separately rolls a {{tip|critical strike}}.
** The second strike does not trigger {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}}.
* If the stacks expire during the empowered attack's first strike animation, the attack cancels and the normal basic attack windup starts. {{bug|1}}
* ''Double Strike'' does not cause '''Master Yi''' to attack twice. Effects that trigger on completing the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Double Strike''. (e.g. {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
* Since ''Double Strike'' resets the counter with the first strike, and the second strike applies on-hit effects, the second strike is able to add a stack for the next ''Double Strike'' activation.
* If ''Double Strike's'' target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} shortly after the triggering attack, it will still occur and deal its effects as usual.
* Basic attacks that are {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, {{tip|block|blocked}}, or missed while '''Master Yi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} will not generate any stacks of ''Double Strike'' nor refresh the duration of active stacks.
* ''Double Strike's'' interaction with parry effects at 3 stacks (the damage of the strikes is negated in all cases):
** If the triggering basic attack is {{tip|dodge|dodged}}, '''Master Yi''' will not perform the second strike nor consume the stacks.
** If the triggering basic attack is {{tip|block|blocked}}, '''Master Yi''' will perform the second strike but not consume the stacks.
** If the triggering basic attack misses while '''Master Yi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}, he will consume the stacks.
*** The second strike will fail to hit the target at all if the triggering attack misses. {{tip|On-attack}} effects do not occur, despite the attack animation playing.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Innate: Master Yi basic attacks generate a stack of Double Strike for a few seconds. At 3 stacks, his next basic attack will consume them all to strike a second time for reduced physical damage.

description.plain: Innate: Master Yi's basic attacks on-hit generate a stack of Double Strike for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, Master Yi's next basic attack on-attack is empowered to consume the stacks on-hit and strike twice, the second strike dealing 50% AD physical damage.

description2.plain: The second strike applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description3.plain: If Master Yi's primary target is killed before the second strike, he will automatically target another nearby enemy.

description4.plain: The second strike can critically strike against structures.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After {{rutngt|0.2}}, he marks the target enemy and then proceeds to mark the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} un-marked enemy within 600 units, recurring every {{rutngt|0.2}}{{ft|up to 3 times.|for a total of 4 marks.}}If there are no other un-marked targets before then, '''Master Yi''' can mark the same enemies again. During ''Alpha Strike'', '''Master Yi''' can select a direction from the primary target.
params.description2: Upon finishing marking, '''Master Yi''' {{tip|blinks|reappears}} 75 units in the targeted direction, or in front of the target otherwise, and then becomes able to act again{{ft|after {{rutngt|0.15}}.|{{tt|{{fd|1.087}} seconds total|Effective time due to game ticks}} after the start of the cast with 4 bounces.}}If the primary target {{tip|death|dies}} or is too far away during the delay, '''Master Yi''' will reappear at the initial cast location instead.
params.description3: '''Master Yi''' then detonates the marks to deal {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 75% effectiveness. Marks after the first on the same target instead detonate instantly upon application to deal {{fd|25}}% damage and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to {{ap|75*0.25}}% effectiveness. ''Alpha Strike'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monster|monsters}} per hit.

params.description5: {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} reduce ''Alpha Strike's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 1 second.
params.description6: ''{{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} can be cast during Alpha Strike. Each time Alpha Strike hits a target, the '''current''' durations of {{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} are refreshed. Alpha Strike's {{tip|cast instance}} does not trigger its cooldown reduction nor grant a stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} when applying on-hit effects.''
params.notes:
* ''Alpha Strike's'' primary damage applies after '''Master Yi''' reappears.
* ''Alpha Strike's'' {{sti|cooldown reduction}} applies on {{tip|turret|structures}}.
* When '''Master Yi''' bounces from a unit it will grant {{tip|sight|vision}} in a 600 radius around it for up to {{rutngt|0.6}}<!-- this 0.6s after reappearing value is not confirmed as "the one", btw, might also be 0.625s after reappearing or 0.75s after last bounce --> after ''Alpha Strike'' ends, including across terrain, though not into {{tip|brush}}.
** It will always grant vision around the primary target, even if he doesn't bounce off it.
* ''Alpha Strike's'' damage is calculated at the moment that each mark is placed. Because of this, it is possible to inflict differing amounts of damage if '''Master Yi's '''{{as|AD}} changes between marks.
* '''Master Yi''' will follow all his primary target's movements.
** ''Alpha Strike'' can only follow up-to {{tt|2000|From Yi's location at start of cast}} units; If the target teleports a very long distance, it will not be followed.
* While vanished, the initial cast location of ''Alpha Strike'' counts as '''Master Yi's''' position, which is considered for effects such as {{tip|tether|tethers}}.
* If the primary target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} and there are no other nearby valid targets, ''Alpha Strike'' will end prematurely and will not deal the damage occurring after '''Master Yi's''' reappearance.
* The choice of exit direction occurs through an indicator anchored to the target during the time that '''Master Yi''' is vanished. You are unable to choose the exit direction after the third mark.{{bug}} Selection commands (default: MB1/left click) and movement commands (default: MB2/right click) are both valid.
** Multiple commands can be issued, but only the ''final'' command before exiting will determine the direction.
* If the primary target is a champion, '''Master Yi''' will be automatically ordered to basic attack them after ''Alpha Strike'' ends.
** '''Master Yi''' will not be able to buffer other abilities.{{bug}}
* Only the first instance of damage counts as a hit for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* ''Alpha Strike'' does not interact with {{cai|Permafrost|Sejuani}}. {{bug|2}}
* ''Alpha Strike'' does not stack {{ri|Press the Attack}} as it is always tagged as dealing [[AoE]] damage.
* While {{tip|basic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} can stack {{ri|Conqueror}} multiple times regardless of ''cast instance'', ''Alpha Strike'' is unique in that it is the only multi {{tip|on-hit}} effect to stack just once for being a single cast instance and for not being {{tip|basic damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.
* On-hit damage applied by ''Alpha Strike'' will be negated by {{tip|dodge}} and {{tip|block}}, but not while '''Master Yi''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
** ''Alpha Strike's'' own damage will not be negated.
* If '''Master Yi''' {{tip|death|dies}} during ''Alpha Strike'' and he is only focusing one target, the ability will only deal the reduced damage strikes and not the final tick of damage from reappearing.
** If he is striking multiple targets the damage will be dealt immediately when ''dying'', and if he ''dies'' before the bounce from the last target, ''Alpha Strike'' will deal reduced damage only to all units he already bounced from.{{bug}}
* If '''Master Yi''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} during ''Alpha Strike'' and he is only focusing one target, the ability will deal the reduced damage strikes as normal and the final tick of damage after being ''resurrected''.
** If he is striking multiple targets, ''Alpha Strike'' will ''sometimes'' deal the reduced damage from repeated bounces and the main damage after being ''resurrected'', and ''sometimes'' only the reduced damage, unrelated to the number of targets available.{{bug}}
{{safesubst:unexpected|desc=
* The exclusion for the cooldown reduction and ''Double Strike'' stacks also applies for effects that apply as part of ''Alpha Strike's'' cast instance (e.g {{ii|Statikk Shiv}}, {{ii|Dusk and Dawn}}). [https://youtu.be/vcy5f1l_V0w] {{bug|2}}|affectedEffects=Master Yi Q; Cast Instance|estimatedPatchOrigin=V12.5|<!--added automatically-->wikiUploadTimestamp=1790094869|<!--added automatically-->pagename=Template:Data Master Yi/Alpha Strike
}}
